pois.name: سوق التوابل
pois.intro: Dubai Spice Souk or the Old Souk is a traditional market in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The Spice Souk is located in Deira, in eastern Dubai, and is adjacent to the Dubai Gold Souk.

pois.name: معبد هندوسي
pois.address: شارع علي بن أبي طالب, دبي
pois.intro: The Dubai Hindu Temple is a place of worship for Hindus in Jebel Ali, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The temple caters to the large Hindu community in the UAE. The temple complex, initially established in 1958 in Bur Dubai, comprised the Shiva Mandir, Krishna Mandir, and Gurudwara.

pois.name: Saeed Al Maktoum House
pois.intro: Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House is a historic building and former residential quarters of Saeed bin Maktoum Al Maktoum, former ruler of Dubai in the United Arab Emirates. The building is located along the Dubai Creek in the locality of Al Shindagha area.

pois.name: برج خليفة
pois.address: 1 شارع الشيخ محمد بن راشد, دبي
pois.intro: The Burj Khalifa is a megatall skyscraper in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Designed by the SOM architectural firm, it is the world's tallest structure, with a total height of 829.8 m and a roof height of 828 m.

pois.name: دبي مول
pois.intro: Dubai Mall is the largest shopping mall in Dubai. The mall is part of Downtown Dubai and is located adjacent to the Burj Khalifa.

pois.name: نافورة دبي
pois.intro: The Dubai Fountain contains a choreographed fountain system located on the 12-hectare artificial Burj Khalifa Lake, at the center of the Downtown Dubai development in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It was designed by WET Design, a California-based company also responsible for the fountains at the Bellagio Hotel Lake in Las Vegas.

pois.name: برواز دبي
pois.intro: The Dubai Frame is an observatory, museum and monument in Zabeel Park, Dubai. It holds the record for the largest frame in the world.

pois.name: متحف المستقبل
pois.description: Branded as a technology museum many visitors considered it more to be an expensive art museum in a beautiful building.
pois.intro: Museum of the Future is a building located in the Financial District of Dubai, UAE. The museum, with 7 floors, is dedicated to exploring the future of science, technology, and innovation. It is housed in a torus-shaped building with windows in the form of a poem in Arabic about the future, written by Dubai ruler Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

pois.name: حي الفهيدي التاريخي
pois.intro: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood is a historic district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

pois.name: محمية رأس الخور للحياة البرية
pois.description: Closed for major renovations. Expected to reopen at the end of 2026.
pois.intro: Ras Al Khor or Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a wetland reserve in Dubai, renowned for attracting large numbers of migratory birds. It is also home to a large population of crustaceans, small mammals, and fish.

pois.name: Deira Gold Souk
pois.intro: Dubai Gold Souk or Gold Souk, is a traditional market in Dubai, UAE. The souk is located in Dubai's commercial business district in Deira, in the locality of Al Ras. The souk consists of over 380 retailers, most of whom are jewelry traders.

pois.name: Deira Clocktower
pois.intro: Deira Clocktower, originally referred to as the Dubai Clock Tower, is a roundabout in Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The Daily Telegraph newspaper listed the Dubai Clock Tower among the 17 of the world's most beautiful clock towers.

pois.name: بلدية دبي
pois.intro: Dubai Municipality is the Government of Dubai municipal body with jurisdiction over city services and the upkeep of facilities in the Emirate of Dubai, United Arab Emirates and reports directly to the Dubai Executive Council. The agency is led by a Director-General that sits at the Dubai Executive Council.

pois.name: حديقة زعبيل
pois.intro: Zabeel Park is an urban public park located in the Zabeel district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It is bounded by Sheikh Rashid Road to the north, the Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed Road to the northwest, while the Sheikh Zayed Road cuts through the south.

pois.name: ديرة سيتي سنتر
pois.intro: City Centre Deira is a mall located in Port Saeed, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and is the original flagship mall in the Majid Al Futtaim Properties portfolio. City Centre Deira opened on 28 November 1995.

pois.name: دبي أكواريوم وحديقة الحيوانات المائية
pois.intro: The Dubai Aquarium and Underwater Zoo is a public aquarium located in the Dubai Mall. It is the biggest aquarium in Dubai and one of the largest in the world.

pois.name: Sheikh Obaid bin Thani House
pois.intro: The Sheikh Obaid bin Thani House is a historic building and former residence of Sheikh Obaid bin Thani, located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The house was built of stone from the sea, gypsum, and mud in 1916.

pois.name: متحف الاتحاد
pois.intro: The Etihad Museum, historically called the Union House and formerly as the al-Diyafah Palace and the Jumeirah Guesthouse, is a museum in Dubai, United Arab Emirates that collects, preserves, and displays the heritage of the United Arab Emirates in the areas of social, political, cultural, scientific, and military history.

pois.name: Dubai Municipality Museum
pois.intro: Dubai Municipality Museum is a heritage site located in the Emirate of Dubai. Established in 1957, it housed the headquarters of Dubai Municipality until 1964, when the municipality moved to a new building on Al Maktoum Street.

pois.name: Coins Museum
pois.intro: The Coins Museum in Dubai, also known as "The Coins Museum in Bur Dubai," is located in the Emirate of Dubai in the United Arab Emirates in Al-Bastakia, Bur Dubai.

pois.name: Coffee Museum
pois.intro: The Dubai Coffee Museum is a museum about coffee located in the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It focuses on the history of coffee, coffee culture, and the working conditions of coffee plantation workers.

pois.name: سوق دبي للمنسوجات
pois.intro: The Dubai Textile Souk is a traditional souq of textile products in Dubai's historic Bur Dubai neighbourhood, along the Dubai Creek. It is located in the United Arab Emirates.

pois.name: The Green Planet
pois.intro: The Green Planet is an indoor zoo and garden in the City Walk area of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It has over 3,000 plants and animals in its artificial "bio-dome" tropical rainforest including birds, reptiles, and fish.

pois.name: دبي دولفيناريوم
pois.intro: Dubai Dolphinarium is an indoor dolphinarium in the Middle East, providing habitat to dolphins and seals, allowing the public to watch and interact with them through live shows and photo sessions. It is located at Creek Park near the Children's City within the vicinity of Oud Metha and Bur Dubai.

pois.name: Kathhiyawadi Thali Restaurant
pois.address: Al Kifaf building B block 4a Street, دبي

pois.name: Bombay Naan Cafeteria LLC
pois.address: Shop No. 4, Al Dhagaya Street, Al Sabkha Road, Deira, Dubai

pois.name: سوق الواجهة البحرية
pois.intro: Waterfront Market is a fish, meat, fruit, and vegetable market in Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The market, which has been functioning since 2017, is recognised as the largest food market in Dubai with over 800 traders trading over 800 tonnes of fresh food everyday.

pois.name: محمية رأس الخور للحياة البرية
pois.intro: Ras Al Khor or Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a wetland reserve in Dubai, renowned for attracting large numbers of migratory birds. It is also home to a large population of crustaceans, small mammals, and fish.

pois.name: Sky Views Dubai
pois.description: This hotel building offers beautiful views toward Burj Khalifa from its 53rd floor. There is a 25m glass floor walk and a ride on a glass slide included. For another 714 AED a walk along the edge of this building floor can be booked.

pois.name: Nesto Hypermarket
pois.intro: Nesto Group is a retail chain headquartered in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2004 by K. P. Basheer, it operates hypermarkets and supermarkets across Gulf Cooperation Council countries and India.

terminalResolution.notes: Major cruise port missing from the list; Jebel Ali was listed instead but is a container port.
